features.feature: Binding store persisted at .lattice/story/actives/<id>/red-target-bindings.json, schema proofstory.red_target_bindings.v1 (file-level shape: schemaVersion, storyId, bindings[], createdAt, updatedAt)
Exactly ONE binding per acceptanceTargetRef; a second write for the same ref is a duplicate-target rejection, not an overwrite

targetBindingDigest = CANON over exactly the 3-field subobject {acceptanceTargetRef,adapterId,testCaseRef} ONLY, createdAt (and any other storage metadata) STRIPPED; CANON over a STORED entry (incl. createdAt) must NOT equal the digest while CANON over the stripped subobject MUST (direction verified correct in CHK-002's happy/edge intents)
Mutation only via the registered, lease-gated command red_evidence_binding_set(storyId, acceptanceTargetRef, adapterId, testCaseRef)

Binding-freeze rule: setting a binding is legal only while the target chain is EMPTY or its head is a quarantine record; once a run record exists on an unquarantined chain the binding is frozen for that target
features.excluded_by: background.md Conversational Texture + understanding.json constraints: 'the §1.1.3 binding-freeze rule (needs chain-head semantics, lands with the chain in W2c; vacuous today as no v2 record exists)' -- note: decision.json itself does not carry this defer text (see openQuestions/summary caveat)

features.feature: Committed-tree reader / anti-swap rule: the reader resolves a binding from <ref>:.lattice/story/actives/<id>/red-target-bindings.json via git show, never the live story directory
A green-confirm's tree MUST carry a binding whose CANON digest equals the governing red-assert's targetBindingDigest, else the green run is rejected
features.excluded_by: background.md/understanding.json: 'any chain record append or read' is out of scope -- red_evidence_green_confirm does not exist yet

features.feature: RED-assert run-time validation: the assertion's adapterId/testCaseRef MUST equal the committed binding and targetBindingDigest MUST recompute, else rejected (§1.6 R1-6)
features.excluded_by: understanding.json constraints: 'run-time adapterId/testCaseRefPattern validation (runner), R1-5/R1-6' fenced to the runner story

features.feature: §3.3 write-time gate: red_evidence_binding_set rejects any acceptanceTargetRef not in expectedRedTargets
§3.3 write-time membership gate also applies identically to the four chain-append operations (red-assert/green-confirm/quarantine/recover)
features.excluded_by: these four commands do not exist yet in this story; background.md fences them to 'four later high-semantics commands'

features.feature: expectedRedTargets is exported as a shared resolver WITHOUT changing its computed set (pure extraction from the module-private core/proofstory.ts function)
§4.1 owner-lease gate: enforceStoryOwnerLeaseGate rejects the command when another session holds an ACTIVE lease
§4.1 actor mutation authority: resolveAgentMutationAuthority classifies the acting identity and fails closed on conflicting identities ([agent_dispatch_identity_conflict])
§4.1 approvedBy is DERIVED (resolved actor + lease sessionId, serialized as <actor>@<sessionId>), recorded on the record and covered by recordDigest, deliberately excluded from the §3.4 operation key
features.excluded_by: this rule governs the four chain-record operations' recordDigest-covered fields; the §1.1.3 binding store schema has no approvedBy field at all, so it is not applicable to red_evidence_binding_set
